verdict_text:
NO

The plan's bfloat16 cast regex only matches `attention.query_key_value.weight`, `mlp.dense_h_to_4h.weight`, and `mlp.dense_4h_to_h.weight`, omitting `attention.dense.weight` — so only 48 of the required 64 projection matrices (Required result item 1) are cast to bfloat16, leaving `attention.dense.weight` in float32 across all 16 layers. Additionally, the plan never asserts "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16" as mandated by Required checks; the count assert before the cast checks 48 target matches (matching the incomplete regex), and no post-cast bfloat16-count check exists at all, so this bug would not be caught before writing output.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
